title: In Aid of the Myreque
start: Talk to Veliaf in the Myreque Hideout, beneath the pub in Canifis.

items.t: Items marked with † can be easily acquired during the quest by either obtaining them from the surrounding area or by purchasing them from Razmire's store, if you have completed Shades of Mort'ton.
A silver weapon (silver bolts do not work, havensilver weapons will not work against the juvinates in the Burgh de Rott general store), and armour to beat several enemies up to level 68
For building the pub, general store and bank:
1–5 buckets † (can be picked up by the well in Burgh de Rott)
11 regular planks † (protean planks do not work)
36–45 nails of any metal (you might get enough of them from mining the rubble)

Either 10 raw mackerel † or 10 raw snails † (depending on the store-owner's choice; any size or combination works), or a weapon and big fishing net to gather them yourself. Mackerel can be obtained at the boat dock south-east of the pub, and snails can be obtained in Morytania.
For building the furnace (these items can be kept in the bank but do not keep in the metal bank):
For making the rod of Ivandis (these items can be kept in the bank or metal bank):
1 cosmic and water rune, or a Lvl-1 enchant tablet.

recommended.t: Completion of Shades of Mort'ton for access to Razmire Builders' Merchants.
50 coins or a ring of charos (a)
A second silver weapon to provide to Ivan (not recoverable)

Steel equipment (med helm, chainbody, and platelegs) and food for Ivan (up to 15 pieces of cooked snails, salmon, slimy eel or stew). This is only needed for lower level players, as the enemies you have to protect Ivan from mainly focus their attacks on the player. (not recoverable)
1–2 Guthix balance potions for the journey.
Attuning the boss portal from War's Retreat to the Barrows Brothers provides an easy teleport to a bank chest and a way past Mort Myre Swamp.

rewards.t: Access to Burgh de Rott and its facilities
Ability to play the Temple Trekking minigame
Ability to use a Gadderhammer, which is strong against shades
Ability to make and use the rod of Ivandis and Guthix balance potions to fight and defeat Vampyre Juveniles and Juvinates
Talk to Historian Minas to receive 5 kudos in the Varrock Museum

steps.t: In the hideout behind the Canifis pub, go through the secret wall and squeeze past the stalagmite on the east side of the cave
Talk to Veliaf Hurtz. [Chat: 1 I want to join your organisation. › 3 Can you tell me about the job? › Accept › 1 Ok, I'll do the job.]

Travel to Mort'ton. The fastest way is by heading south of the cave, exiting through the doors, climbing the same tree from In Search of the Myreque and using the swamp boat south, or using a portal to the Barrows in War's Retreat.

sub.t: If you need a piece of food, there are snails to the west of Mort'ton that can be cooked with level 12 Cooking.

steps.t: Speak to Florin, south of the bridge to Burgh de Rott, who won't let you pass yet. (Make sure to finish dialogue options)
Search the chest.
Use food on the chest.
Jump the gate.
Talk to Florin. [Chat: 4 Are there any 'out of the way' places in here? › 5 Ok, thanks!]
Climb over the broken down wall in the building just south-east of the well. It'll be near an unreachable pile of rubble that you can mine.
Mine the rubble to clear the trap door, then open the trapdoor and climb down.
Mine and use spade to remove all the rubble piles (15). Your bucket can be emptied on the pile outside the pub.

sub.t: 1 bucket will allow you to mine 3 piles before it needs to be emptied in the pile outside. There is a bucket next to the well if you need one.
Bucket(s) of rubble may be disassembled or alchemized to avoid the need to empty them outside.
Any items left on the ground when you climb back up the ladder will be lost.

steps.t: Go up and talk to any villager. [Chat: 3 I'd like to help fix up the town. › 4 Ok, thanks.]
Talk to Aurel in the general store. [Chat: 3 I'd like to help fix up the town. › 4 What should I do now? › 5 Ok, thanks.]
Climb the ladder outside and use a plank on the Broken Roof (3 planks, 12 nails required).
Climb down and use a plank on the damaged wall (3 planks, 12 nails required).
Talk to Aurel. [Chat: 4 What should I do now? › 5 Ok, thanks.]

Fill the box with supplies: 10 bronze hatchet, 3 tinderbox and 10 raw mackerel or snails. The snails can be cooked or raw (depending on what Aurel asked for, check the in-game quest journal if you forget).
Return the crate to Aurel.
Talk to Cornelius in the bank. [Chat: 4 What should I do now? › 5 Ok, thanks.]
Use 2 planks on the bank booth covered in broken glass while holding 1 swamp paste and 8 nails (any kind).
Use 3 planks and 12 nails on the wall behind it.
Talk to Cornelius. [Chat: 4 What should I do now? › 3 Do you fancy the job?]
Talk to any villager. [Chat: 4 What should I do now? › 5 Ok, thanks.]
Use two steel bars and a piece of coal on the furnace to the east.
Search the furnace to light it. [Chat: 1 yes]
Talk to Gadderanks in the general store.
Talk to everyone else in the general store but Aurel.
Kill Gadderanks and the vampyres. (The vampyres can only be damaged by a silver melee weapon)
p: Florin is contented with the food.

steps.t: Talk to Gadderanks.
Talk to Veliaf.
Talk to Veliaf in the Canifis hideout (Take Melee Gear and Sickle). [Chat: 5 Ok, thanks.]
Dismiss your followers if you have any.
Talk to Polmafi then Radigad then Ivan.
Route 1 is generally easier:

Enter the Mausoleum west of Canifis and talk to Drezel until he gives you a key. [Chat: 2 I found out some things about Efaritay.] then [Chat: 1 Veliaf told me about Ivandis. › 4 Is there somewhere that I might get more information about Ivandis? › 3 The lives of those pitiful few left in Morytania could rest on this!]
Use the key on the east wall, then climb the secret trapdoor.
Find and read the book titled 'The Sleeping Seven' on the westernmost middle-bookcase.
Return to Canifis and enter the trapdoor south of the pub.
Leave the pub cellar via the south wall and smash the wooden boards on the eastern wall.
Enter and use soft clay on the tomb, then add the rod clay mould to your tool belt.
Smelt a silvthril rod at any furnace (under the Silver Casting section).
Enchant it using the Lvl-1 Enchant spell.
With a rope and the enchanted rod in your inventory, return to Drezel, located underground in the mausoleum west of Paterdomus.
Use the rod on the well in the room west of Drezel to receive the rod of ivandis.
Go back to Burgh de Rott, and go to the cellar in the pub where you previously cleared the rubble.
p: Clearing the entrance to the inn basement.
Clearing rubble from the floor of the pub's basement.

steps.t: Talk to Veliaf. [Chat: 1 I have brought you the Rod of Ivandis! › 1 Yes, I've come to give the Rod of Ivandis to you!]
Quest complete!

p: Vanstrom and Gadderanks talk about tithes.
The 2 possible routes by which to guide Ivan.
Dipping the rod in the Salve
